Product Features

  • Tall and spacious: The total dimensions are 55*40*200 cm. The tall cabinet design expands the space vertically without taking up much floor space, making it suitable for various living spaces.
  • Multi-layer storage: The upper glass door of the cabinet has 3 inner layers, the lower cabinet door has 2 inner layers, as well as a drawer. This creates a versatile storage system that meets the requirements for clear storage.
  • Transparent presentation: The upper cabinet doors are made of glass and reveal the books, decorations and other items inside, making the collection the visual focal point of the room.
  • Double Handle Design: The cabinet door is equipped with two types of handles: a round aluminum alloy handle and a long iron pull rod handle, which combines aesthetics and functionality, making it easy to open and close.
  • Generous storage space: Multi-layered dividers and drawers provide ample space for neatly storing various items, books, household goods, etc., eliminating clutter.
  • Sturdy Material: Made of chipboard, the construction is sturdy and durable, can support various items stably, and is not easily deformed even with long-term use.
  • Clean and Pure Appearance: The overall design is white, plain and clear, and easily adapts to different interior styles such as modern, Nordic and American, making the room look brighter.
  • Multifunctional: It serves both as a display case to display decorations and collectibles and as a storage cabinet for various items, thus combining display and practical functions.
  • Exquisite Details: The combination of glass cabinet doors and staggered shelves, as well as two types of handles, makes the tall cabinet not only practical, but also more elegant and aesthetically pleasing, adding style to the home.
  • Note: Due to different shooting conditions and display devices, there may be slight color variations between the actual product and the image. This is normal and not a quality defect. We strive to display the product color as faithfully as possible. Please only order if this is important to you.

Descriptions

Descriptions

Total dimensions: 55*40*200 cm. It is a tall display case with a drawer and two doors. The upper door is made of glass and the interior is divided into three compartments. The lower door is divided into two parts. All doors are equipped with handles: round aluminum alloy handles and long iron handles. The display case offers plenty of storage space and is white with a chipboard construction.
